newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes raid south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes raid south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli planes raided suspected Moslem guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Friday, security sources said.
They said two planes fired eight rockets at ad-Dahr Daidaba ridges south of Syrian-controlled Bekaa valley.

The raid targeted an area where pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas clashed with Israeli forces in south Lebanon on Thursday night, killing three Israeli soldiers and wounding seven, according to the Israeli army.

After the clash north of Israel's occupation zone, Israeli helicopters twice struck Hizbollah bases just outside the zone overnight. In a separate attack, a helicopter rocketed a Lebanese army checkpoint north of the zone, the security sources said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the latest air raid.
